state.paragraph: Also on October 7, 2013, Kirkland delivered to Goodwin Procter a revised draft of the merger agreement which, among other things, proposed a $15 million Mac-Gray termination fee, which represented approximately 4.4% of the total equity value of the transaction, and certain positions on the scope of various post-signing covenants.
